## What an Options Strategy Really Costs


Since both brokers charge ₹20 per options order, your brokerage depends on **how many orders your strategy places** , not on which broker you pick.

*Brokerage only. These figures exclude STT, exchange charges, GST, stamp duty and slippage.*


Every entry, exit and adjustment is a separate order. A strategy that adjusts often can cost several times more than its first entry suggests.


Statutory costs also went up this year. From 1 April 2026, STT on options is 0.15% of the premium on the sell side, and on futures it is 0.05% on the sell side.


**Upstox Plus is priced differently,** with brokerage of up to ₹30 per order. Special rates on some orders placed in Upstox’s own apps may not apply to orders placed through third-party platforms.

## Options Tools: Upstox Pro vs Zerodha Kite


Both brokers give you the basics: option chains, charts and multi-leg order entry. The differences are in where the extra tools live.


**Upstox:**


-


Upstox Pro includes charts, an option chain, payoff graphs and options data such as Greeks, open interest and PCR.


-


Algoverse lets you build no-code strategies, backtest them, paper trade and deploy them, with 80+ indicators.


-


You can also trigger algos from TradingView alerts.


**Zerodha:**


-


Kite handles trading and charts, and Console handles P&L and tax reports.


-


Many advanced options and strategy tools come from partner platforms built on Kite Connect, such as Sensibull and Streak.


-


Partner tools may have their own pricing, separate from Zerodha.


Feature access can depend on the app and plan you use, so check the latest version before you decide.

## How to Test a Strategy Before Trading with Upstox or Zerodha


Brokerage is easy to compare. Whether your strategy holds up is harder to know, and it matters more.


Before you go live with either broker, ask yourself four questions:


-


Would these rules have worked in past markets, including bad weeks and not just good ones?


-


How many orders does the strategy place, and what do brokerage, taxes and slippage add up to?


-


What is the worst drawdown, and could you sit through it without changing the rules?


-


Can you follow the rules in live markets, where fills and timing are less predictable?


Backtesting answers the first three on historical data. Paper trading helps with the fourth before you risk capital.


You can[backtest options strategies on AlgoTest](https://algotest.in/feature/backtest) with an account at either broker. Testing is separate from live execution, so your broker choice doesn’t limit what you can test.

-


A second account lets you keep trading if one broker has an outage on a busy day.


-


You can run different strategies on different accounts and track them separately.


-


You can use Zerodha for MCX strategies, since AlgoTest currently runs[MCX execution](https://algotest.in/blog/how-to-read-mcx-option-chain) only through Zerodha.

### FAQs


#### Is Upstox or Zerodha better for options trading?


Both charge ₹20 per options order, so brokerage is the same. The choice depends on the tools you prefer, your futures and intraday volumes, and how you plan to test and automate strategies.


#### Is Upstox or Zerodha better for option selling?


Brokerage and STT are the same with both. Option sellers should compare margin requirements on their usual positions, order handling for multi-leg trades and API reliability if they automate.


#### Can I use Upstox and Zerodha together?


Yes. You can hold accounts with both brokers and connect both on AlgoTest, then choose which account each strategy runs on.


#### Is the Upstox or Zerodha API free?


Upstox lists its trading API as free, including data. Zerodha’s Personal plan is free for orders, but live and historical data need the Connect plan at ₹500 per app per month.


#### Can I backtest options strategies with Upstox or Zerodha?


Upstox offers backtesting through Algoverse, and Zerodha users can backtest through partner platforms such as Streak. You can also backtest options strategies on AlgoTest with an account at either broker.


#### Does a good backtest guarantee profits?


No. A backtest shows how your rules performed on past data. Live markets bring slippage and conditions the past may not include, so paper trade first and start small.
